theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (lam Lam : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (η : Rn n → ℝ) (c : Rn ℓ), 0 < lam → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ A P P) → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |A P Q| ≤ Lam * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V U → ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ V x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (η x ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ V x‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * Lam ^ 2 / lam ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖V x - c‖ ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ η x‖ ^ 2)
